audit_items.proof_trace: Exception handler at L124 only catches AbiException and OverflowException, but malformed ABI offsets cause Buffer.BlockCopy (via Slice) to throw ArgumentException, which propagates uncaught. This causes uncontrolled node failure instead of clean block rejection via InvalidBlockException.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts deposit log with out-of-bounds offset in ABI-encoded event data. During DecodeDepositRequest, ABI decoder reads malformed offset, attempts data.Slice with invalid bounds, Buffer.BlockCopy throws ArgumentException which escapes catch block, causing node crash or improper block handling.
